description: Boston Buildings with Roof Breaks is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. This dataset represents building roof outlines for all buildings in Boston. This dataset was created initially from a flyover in 2011 and is updated periodically based on the aerial imagery and LIDAR data. The layer is maintained by the City of Boston Planning Department's GIS Lab. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are buildings, footprints, roofbreaks. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
